errata.reason: Original KSV-001 target was resolved to KSV-0001, which checks privilege escalation, not the privileged field labelled in these fixtures. A true escalation finding must not be called a false positive for a different field. Preserve both frozen labels and observations, mark their binding ungraded, and propose a separately versioned future correction.

limitations: 28 small synthetic paired repositories; engineering holdout, no blind reviewer study
Two frozen Kubernetes rule bindings ungraded; labels and original comparison retained
One primary alert per repository; incidental alerts unlabelled and not triaged
Unsupported categories excluded from recall; incomplete coverage never clean
Deterministic heuristic provider; unsupported Trivy rules abstain
Valid citations do not ensure semantic truth; poisoned advice remains advisory
Heuristic secret redaction is not complete DLP; zero violations only in declared corpus
No live hosted quality, billing, peak memory or production-scale measurement
